population: pregnant women across gestation and early postpartum
notes: Multi-line-cell regression case. Cells such as '0.7 ±\n            0.1 (0.6-0.8)' are wrapped across source lines. "".join(col.stripped_strings) strips each text node's OUTER whitespace but kept the newline between them, so a single Markdown row was emitted across several physical lines; row widths collapsed to 0/1/3 instead of 8 and remove_empty_col_row() then raised IndexError indexing past the end of a short row. prepare_paper.py swallowed that exception, so table_2.md shipped to the model as caption + footnotes with NO grid at all -- the table was silently never curated, while the paper still reported 94 rows from table_1 and scored as a success. The table also has colspan=8 drug-group section rows (Citalopram / Escitlopram / Sertaline), which expand to a repeated label across the row; that is faithful and intentional. Only the deterministic stage-00 oracle is bundled.

oracle_kind.stage_00_markdown: deterministic (byte-exact; enforced by test_stage0_conversion.py). Verified by hand against the source markup: every data row must have the same width as the header, and each wrapped cell must read as one value, e.g. '0.7 ± 0.1 (0.6-0.8)'.
